parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, no facility or document restriction targeting visitors, and no documented police targeting. Social record is mixed: dated (2004–2007) harassment of an LGB couple, acknowledged stigma of gender-diverse youth under conservative religious norms, and 'discreetly out' cultural expectation (social friction/hostility-lite), alongside working LGBT venues, equality organisations, and marriage recognition imposed and upheld by the governing state's top court — evidence of functioning institutions that have delivered pro-LGBT outcomes, which extends only partially to trans people since the 2012 code enumerates sexual orientation alone. Trans-specific law, custody placement, and border practice are open questions, not exposures. Extrapolating from structural signals — no enforcement against gender-nonconforming people, rule-of-law framework, tolerant-with-friction society — this sits in the reduced-risk band, slightly below the 0.75 dead-letter-statute-with-documented-respect profiles because trans-specific acceptance is thinner and the dated hostility record cuts mildly against. Resolves near 0.65–0.70.
